title: Logo usage
slide_intent: Show how different surfaces change the space a signature receives. Seeing actual uses helps a designer decide when the alternate lockup earns its place.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can favor its primary identity across campaign materials while using its stacked form where it offers useful visibility.
demonstration: Website and poster examples share a group with a pen. A separate gray field pairs tote and phone examples at different strengths of emphasis.
practical_value: Check the signature against its intended surface. Use the narrow pen and small phone examples to judge whether a different treatment helps recognition.

content_islands.name: Primary applications
content_islands.spec: Place the guidance beside overlapping website and poster examples and the tall pen specimen.

content_islands.name: Secondary comparisons
content_islands.spec: On the gray field, pair faded and full-strength tote and phone specimens. Keep the explanatory note close to these examples.
